bug_info.bug_desc: The ACK timeout interval for non-isochronous IN transactions is computed incorrectly. The old AckTimeoutCnt parameter used (17 + 3) * 4 = 80, assuming that rx_pkt_start_i is seen 3 bit times after the USB SOP transition. The actual delay is only 1.5 bit times (6 cycles of the 48 MHz clock), and the down-counter also needs a -1 adjustment because it is a [N-1:0] countdown value. As a result, the module waits longer than the required 16-18 bit-time handshake window before declaring a timeout, so a missing ACK is detected too late.
bug_info.fix_hint: Update the AckTimeoutCnt parameter to reflect the real rx_pkt_start_i delay of 1.5 bit times (6 USB clock cycles) and account for the countdown counter representation by subtracting one, i.e. use ((17 * 4) + 6) - 1. Update the nearby comment to describe the corrected SOP-to-rx_pkt_start_i delay.
